_notes: Generated by p2k_memmap.py from the update package's game image and symbol table.
Pinball 2000 CMOS records move between machines: every field names its record ("tag"),
and "start" is the offset inside that record. Resolve the tag through the platform's
tag_directory before reading. A record the machine has not created yet is not readable.
